phase_heading: Phase 2: Bind the other five traffic sources to the release commit
head_drift: git rev-parse HEAD prints 4c34987ca774a5cd6323b4ce5d7bbb5a716797ee, equal to role_base_sha and audited_head_sha. The only non-track commit in range, d90c4c24f, touches apps/storytime only.
applicability_rationale: test-strategy.md P2.9 Review B row: required. The phase changes a fail-closed gate that runs before a production migration on five files.
summary: Phase 2 security audit passes at 4c34987ca. The master-only fetch with the FETCH_HEAD ancestor check closes the D10 fork limit: a commit only on refs/pull/* or on no branch stops with the 8.6 line and exit 1, and any other git error stops with the 8.7 line and a non-zero exit, never a pass. The SHA is validated before any git call, the default literal stops the run, the URL is fixed in all five files, the bind step is step 1 everywhere (before refuse-legacy-db in Primary), no secret reaches the log, and the trap cleans the scratch folder on every exit path.
evidence: Provenance: git rev-parse HEAD = 4c34987ca774a5cd6323b4ce5d7bbb5a716797ee (exit 0); git diff --name-only 17a26b07..HEAD lists only allowed P2.2 paths plus apps/storytime/__tests__/look-adversarial-p2-r4.test.ts (other track).

SHA gate before git: scripts/ci/verify-traffic-source.sh lines 130-133; git init at line 146. Dynamic: default literal REQUIRED_RELEASE_COMMIT_SHA exit 1; uppercase 40-hex exit 1; 39-hex exit 1; --upload-pack=evil exit 1; each prints the 40-lowercase-hex message with a garbage URL, so no fetch ran.
URL and upload gates: lines 135-137 (dash-leading -x exit 1; empty exit 1); line 138 (/no/such/dir exit 1).

Fetch and compare: line 150 fetches origin master once, no --depth, SHA not named; line 153 cat-file -e ^{commit}; lines 156-162 capture merge-base rc: 0 continues, 1 fails with the 8.6 line and exit 1, any other value fails with the 8.7 line. Script lines 154/160/161 match spec 8.6/8.7 text exactly (spec.md lines 214-229).
Fail-closed dynamic proof: valid HEAD SHA + /no/such/repo exits 128 with the git fatal text; ls of /tmp/opencode/verify-traffic-source.* finds nothing (trap cleanup lines 58-62, 143).

Five files: bind-release-source is step 1 in apps/accounts, apps/accounting, apps/codecamp-advantage, apps/marketing, apps/primary-advantage cloudbuild-traffic.yaml; grep -E 'waitFor|continueOn' exits 1; each file holds exactly one fixed GitHub URL literal; the bind step holds no secretEnv, no env, no install; Primary runs bind before refuse-legacy-db (lines 12-34).

Compare hardening: submodule-in-scope fail closed lines 184-189; #!include: fail closed lines 167-169; symlink type and target compared lines 207-221; xargs -- separator line 214; NUL-separated lists; set -euo pipefail line 37 with every git exit guarded or aborting.

Red tests: scripts/ci/__tests__/traffic-source-binding-phase2.test.mjs lines 723-996 assert T-20 to T-25 including a refs/pull/7/head fork fixture and forced merge-base exits 128 and 1. Execution blocked in this sandbox; recorded as a limit.

A2: not applicable, no publish/consent gate. A6: no hit; measure/tracks.md line 1638 says in progress; runbook additions name the step, _RELEASE_COMMIT_SHA, and the stop rule with no resolved/proven wording.

findings_resolution.D10 fork limit: Closed by design in Phase 2: the fetch names only origin master, so a fork-only commit is absent and stops the run. Recorded in Review B phase 1, now resolved by the ancestor check of spec 8.2.
findings_resolution.sandbox limit: vitest run, git init/clone, and file redirection are blocked in this sandbox, so the Red suite and a self-built fixture could not be executed; the Red assertions were read and Green gate evidence in plan.md records tests_failed=0 at the phase head.
